Intel stocks also fell sharply

Outside the tech sector,

Crude oil has hovered near and above $100 a barrel

Choudry led the agency through two tumultuous years.

The ambitious mega project is decades behind schedule
and billions of dollars over budget,
while its proposed route has been scaled back.
Last year, the Trump administration
canceled billions of dollars in federal funds
for what it calls a, quote, "train to nowhere."
The rail authority's board disputes that framing

Joel Rose, NPR News.
- On Wall Street, stocks remain in the red.
